___TEMPLATE_INFO___.description: This is a TEMPLATE showing technical metadata from execution
___TEMPLATE_INFO___.purpose: Performance and system information collected during workflow execution
___TEMPLATE_INFO___.git_status: Real files are NOT committed to Git

___session_id___: Matches the main session file this metadata belongs to
___total_duration___: Total wall-clock time for entire workflow

browser.___headless___: true = invisible, false = visible on screen
browser.___user_agent___: Browser User-Agent string sent to websites

network.___proxy_enabled___: true = proxy was used, false = direct connection
network.___proxy_type___: http, https, or socks5 if proxy_enabled=true
network.___dns_lookup___: Time to resolve DNS (first task only)

performance.___first_byte___: Time until first response byte received
performance.___page_load___: Time for website to fully load
performance.___interaction___: Time spent on user interactions (clicks, typing)
performance.___response_wait___: Average time waiting for AI response

api_calls.___total___: Total number of AI API calls made
api_calls.___input___: Total tokens in all prompts sent
api_calls.___output___: Total tokens in all responses received
api_calls.___estimated_cost___: Rough estimation based on model pricing

browser_interactions.___screenshots___: Number of screenshots taken for debugging

execution_timeline.___init___: Time to initialize browser and adapters
execution_timeline.___save___: Time to save results to disk
execution_timeline.___cleanup___: Time to close browser and cleanup

alerts_and_warnings.message: Response took longer than expected (6.6s > 5.0s threshold)

optimization_suggestions.suggestion: Consider using headless mode to reduce memory footprint
Use GenSpark only for research tasks, not simple queries

___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_DATA___.performance_analysis: Identify slow tasks using tasks_statistics section
___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_DATA___.resource_monitoring: Track memory and CPU from resource_usage section
___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_DATA___.debugging: Check error_statistics and alerts_and_warnings for issues
___HOW_TO_USE_THIS_DATA___.comparison: Compare multiple sessions to identify trends

___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_1: All timings are in milliseconds or seconds as indicated
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_2: Token counts are approximate based on tokenizer used
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_3: Resource usage depends on system and other running processes
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_4: API costs are estimated only - check actual provider billing
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_5: Some metrics may be 0 if feature is not enabled
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_6: Timestamps are UTC (Z suffix in ISO 8601 format)
